input: Find church and faith-based day camps summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Black Mountain, Swannanoa, Montreat and Old Fort, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.

candidates.name: Black Mountain United Methodist Church
candidates.note: Listed a summer 2026 Vacation Bible School event; 2027 details not yet found.

candidates.name: Meadowbrook Free Will Baptist Church of Black Mountain
candidates.note: Evening Discovering Jesus VBS ran August 4–8, 2025, at 204 Blue Ridge Road.

candidates.name: Christmount
candidates.note: Camp Brooke/Girls on the Run day camp ran July 13–17, 2026, from 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

candidates.name: Camp Rockmont
candidates.note: Christian boys’ overnight camps and teen counselor-in-training programs; summer 2027 registration is open.

candidates.name: Cragmont Assembly
candidates.note: Free Will Baptist camp and retreat center offered summer 2026 camp sessions.

candidates.name: Carolinas Fellowship of Christian Athletes
candidates.note: Middle/high-school leadership camp and coaches’ family camp ran at YMCA Blue Ridge Assembly in summer 2026.

candidates.name: Forest Hill Church
candidates.note: Camp Rock for rising grades 4–6 ran July 14–18, 2026, at YMCA Blue Ridge Assembly.

candidates.name: Ridgecrest Summer Camps
candidates.note: Runs Camp Ridgecrest for Boys and Camp Crestridge for Girls; two-week summer 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Lifeway Christian Resources
candidates.note: Centrifuge and MFUGE youth camps at Ridgecrest have summer 2027 sessions, including recreation and mission programming.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Swannanoa
candidates.note: Children’s VBS ran June 14–18, 2026, from 6–8 p.m., with Bible study, music, games and crafts.

candidates.name: Landmark Missionary Baptist Church of Swannanoa
candidates.note: Emerald Crossing VBS was listed in summer 2026 at the church’s 5 Jordan Road location.

candidates.name: Higher Ground Adventures
candidates.note: Week-long Christian overnight adventure camp for teens; found in summer 2026 listings.

candidates.name: Montreat Conference Center
candidates.note: Summer Clubs day camp serves kindergarten graduates through teens; also runs residential youth conferences, with 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: COMPASS pre-college program is announced for June 20–24, 2027; the college also offers summer sports camps.

candidates.name: PASSPORT
candidates.note: PASSPORTkids residential camp at Montreat serves elementary-age church groups; July 2027 sessions confirmed.

candidates.name: First Baptist Church of Old Fort
candidates.note: Emerald Crossing VBS ran July 19–23, 2026, from 5:45–8:45 p.m. at 203 East Main Street.

candidates.name: Cherry Springs Baptist Church of Old Fort
candidates.note: Offered weekly Wednesday evening VBS during June 2026 at 6 Bull Walker Road.

candidates.name: Mount Hebron Wesleyan Church of Old Fort
candidates.note: Evening VBS ran June 28–July 1, 2026, from 6–8:30 p.m.

candidates.name: Moffitt Hill Church of God of Old Fort
candidates.note: Wonder Junction VBS was listed for June 7, 2025, at 344 Moffitt Hill Church Road.
